Name: The Farmers Children - HD Seasonal Portraits talkohlooey-style
Author: Sandman53
Description:
[b][color=#93c47d][size=5]Description[/size][/color][/b]
I wanted some high definition portraits to match what I consider to be one of the best HD portrait mods out there, and I also really loved what xiddav did with the Farmer's Children mod. Sooo why not both? Using inspirations from Slightly Cuter Aesthetic and talkohlooeys mod I created this.

[i]*Please note that this mod does not include vanilla portraits. A blank file is used in its place, so if you do not have HD Portraits installed you will get no portraits.*[/i]

[b][color=#93c47d][size=5]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
You must install the Farmer's Children main file, but do not install the Art file. You will you use the mod in it's place. Extract this archive into your mod folder.

[b][color=#93c47d][size=5]Configuration[/size][/color][/b]
There are a few configuration options. You can individually set each childs Hair, Eye and Skin color. Optionally, if [i][b]LookLikeParent [/b][/i]is set to true then the mod will use pre-defined files that will best match the parent of the child. I have included parent files for all Stardew Valley and Stardew Valley Expanded marriage candidates. More can be added in the future if requested.

[b][color=#93c47d][size=5]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
[font=Arial][size=2]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]
[/url]This mod was designed to work alongside the Slightly Cuter Aesthetic sprite style and talkohlooeys art style.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]
[/size][/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904][font=Arial][size=2]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/size][/font][/url]
